Character Name Generator

Generate character names from real-world cultures — Western, East Asian, South Asian, Middle Eastern, African, Latin — plus a fantasy toggle.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a culture (or fantasy).
  2. Choose how many names to generate.
  3. Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which cultures are included?

Western, East Asian, South Asian, Middle Eastern, African, and Latin — each with authentic-style first and last name banks.

What does the fantasy toggle do?

It swaps the cultural banks for original fantasy syllables to name elves, mages, and warriors.

How do I copy a name?

Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
